shortDescription: Controls illuminate only when in use and fade away when finished, preserving a sleek and seamless design. Fits in a kitchen island, peninsula, or standard cabinet - and at multiple heights - to adapt to your layout and cooking needs.

features.text: Smooth-Glide Drawer
At the touch of a button, the drawer opens and closes smoothly and quietly.
Built-In Drawer Design
Standard Mount Ready and designed to install within cabinetry for a cohesive, built-in look that elevates your kitchen and clears counter space.
Clear view. Easy clean.
A fixed-position control design provides clear visibility and comfortable operation while maintaining a smooth surface that wipes clean easily.
1000-Watt Cooking Power
Cook and defrost quickly and evenly with 1000 watts of microwave power.
Sensor Cook & Reheat Settings
Child Lock Protection
Detects food type and adjusts time and power for consistently great results, including perfectly reheated leftovers.
Locks the controls to help prevent unintended use.
Hands-Free Close
Convenient Top Access
Designed for everyday convenience, the door gently closes itself with a simple nudge.
A lower installation height provides comfortable access and easier dish removal.
Self-Venting Microwave
An integrated vent and filtration system helps capture steam, smoke, and cooking odors from cooking.
Interior LED Lighting
Bright LED lighting illuminates the interior so you can monitor your food while cooking.
Large Capacity
The 1.2 cu. ft. capacity microwave provides plenty of space to heat and cook your favorite dishes with ease.
ADA Compliant
Compliant when installed in accordance with ADA standards.
